subject: Human Body
title: The Electrical Conduction System
description: Learn The Electrical Conduction System in one minute.

hook.text: Each heartbeat follows an electrical pathway. Signals travel from the top of the heart to the bottom in under a second.

buildup.text: From the SA node, the signal reaches the AV node. The AV node delays briefly so the atria finish emptying.

discovery.text: Then the signal races down the bundle of His and Purkinje fibers. The ventricles contract from bottom to top.

twist.text: This bottom-up squeeze pushes blood upward through the valves efficiently. Random contraction would be useless.

climax.text: An EKG records this electrical journey. Each wave and spike maps to a specific part of the heartbeat cycle.

punchline.text: One signal, one path, one perfectly timed squeeze.

quiz.question: Why does the AV node briefly delay the signal?
options: To let the ventricles fill first
To let the atria finish emptying into the ventricles
To prevent the signal from reaching the brain
